intro: Gameweek 11, gentlemen, and Liverpool put four past Man Utd while Brentford did the same to Everton. Chelsea lost 4-1 to Leeds and Newcastle drew 2-2 with Arsenal. Jamie hit 63 and the rest of you looked on. Louie propped up the room on 24. Brahmes got 45 and climbed to third, Asher slipped to fourth on 30, and Jamie crept up to seventh. Ben still leads on 567, 57 clear of Jonny. The title race is not ON. It is a procession.
motw: Jamie, 63 points. Hill got 14, Wirtz got 14 and Strand Larsen got 10 after arriving off the waiver wire in place of Solanke. That's a waiver claim that paid off on the first day. The rest of you were not even in the same postcode. Jamie moves up to seventh and the lads are buzzing.
stinker: Louie, 24 points and last place. The whole gameweek was a Sunday League team sheet. Garner got 4 and Fofana and Estêvão took 2 each from a Chelsea side that shipped four. Absolute scenes, and not the good kind. Slipped to eighth.
bench: Jonny and Louie both left 10 points on the bench. Louie's 10 was the whole of Tzolakis, who kept a clean sheet and made seven saves on the bench. Jonny's 10 was Bogle and Affengruber with 4 each, plus Leno's 2. The bench is where points go to die, and this week it was a mass grave.
bench_jam: Josh gets a rare one. Osula came on for Lindelöf and delivered 5 points with an assist for Newcastle. Josh didn't pick him in the XI, he just got lucky with the auto-sub. Still, a gift is a gift. You can't buy that.
red_card: Brahmes brought in Costinha on waivers, and Brighton's defender repaid him with a red card and -2 points. He was sent off in the 88th minute. A sending-off that late is a hospital ball of a transfer. Brahmes still climbed to third, so the damage was limited.
gloves: Louie again, this time with Raya. One save, two goals conceded and 1 point from 69 minutes. Arsenal drew 2-2 at Newcastle and Raya was involved in the wrong half of it. Not great for the man at the bottom of the table.

xi.571: Tzolakis, 10 points with a clean sheet and seven saves. Louie had him on the bench. You couldn't make it up.
xi.60: Hill, 14 points for Jamie with a clean sheet, an assist and 3 bonus. Absolutely rinsed the Bournemouth backline.
xi.499: Pedro Porro, 11 points for Brahmes with an assist and a clean sheet. The one bright spot in a week with a red card.
xi.555: Silva, 8 points for Josh from a Bournemouth clean sheet and 16 defensive contributions. Quiet and effective.
xi.366: Wirtz, 14 points with a goal, an assist and 3 bonus. In Jamie's pocket and in his team of the week.
xi.183: Rudoni, 10 points for Jack with two assists in a Coventry win over Palace. Played himself into form.
xi.368: Szoboszlai, 9 points for Ben with a goal and a clean sheet. Set and forget.
xi.68: Tavernier, 8 points for Jonny with an assist and a clean sheet. Solid, if not spectacular.
xi.295: McBurnie, 13 points for Asher with two goals and 3 bonus. Asher still had a 30-point week, so spare a thought for the rest of the squad.
xi.222: Strand Larsen, 10 points for Jamie with a goal and an assist in 78 minutes. The waiver pickup that keeps on giving.
xi.346: Calvert-Lewin, 9 points for Ben with a goal and an assist against Chelsea. Ben leads the table and now owns a Leeds forward who has scored against a Chelsea side that conceded four.
